                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Can-daydayup/p/19153572" title="发布于 2025-10-21 09:23">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">在 .NET 9 中使用 Mapster 快速、高效的实现对象映射</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202510/1336199-20251020201130363-1589673397.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>前言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>在日常开发中，我们常常需要将一个对象映射到另一个对象，比如将数据库实体转换为数据传输对象（DTO），或将请求模型映射为领域模型。这个过程通常涉及大量重复性代码，如果每次都手动编写，不仅严重影响开发效率，而且随着项目规模不断增长，还容易出现错误（如：属性遗漏、手写时写错或复制粘贴失误等）。</span></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>本文我们的主要内容就是讲解如何在&nbsp;<code>ASP.NET Core 9.0 Web API</code><span>&nbsp;项目中使用 Mapster 快速、高效的实现对象映射。</span></span></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Mapster 介绍</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Mapster 是一个开源免费（<span>MIT license）、快速、高性能、灵活且易于使用的 .NET 对象映射库，用于在 .NET 用程序中进行对象之间的转换和映射操作，大幅减少手动赋值带来的重复代码、人为错误和维护成本。</span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>开源地址：<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><a href="https://github.com/MapsterMapper/Mapster" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">https://github.com/MapsterMapper/Mapster</span></a></span></strong></li>
<li><strong>在线文档：<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><a href="https://github.com/MapsterMapper/Mapster/wiki" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">https://github.com/MapsterMapper/Mapster/wiki</span></a></span></strong></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202510/1336199-20251020201210868-1996110845.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>安装 Mapster 相关包</span></h2>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>方式一、NuGet 包管理器安装</span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>在 NuGet 包管理器中搜索：<code>Mapster</code><span>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>Mapster.DependencyInjection</code><span>&nbsp;安装：</span></span></span></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong>Mapster 核心功能包</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202510/1336199-20251020201225546-845153124.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>Mapster.DependencyInjection 依赖注入集成包</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202510/1336199-20251020201250387-361575836.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>方式二、.NET CLI 安装</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaLLrZsrvvoxwIlQiafd3svLTRibmoqbyUIwADXzy2eXF1dMRpruTCYsekwRnr7JqfBBBXA8TB2a4WI/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>dotnet add package Mapster --version 7.4.0&nbsp;<span><a class="wx_topic_link" data-topic="1">#核心功能包</a><span><br><span>dotnet add package Mapster.DependencyInjection --version 1.0.1&nbsp;<span><a class="wx_topic_link" data-topic="1">#依赖注入集成包</a><span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>在 Program.cs 中注册 Mapster 服务</span></h2>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaLLrZsrvvoxwIlQiafd3svLTRibmoqbyUIwADXzy2eXF1dMRpruTCYsekwRnr7JqfBBBXA8TB2a4WI/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code>var<span>&nbsp;builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);<span><br><span><br>// 注册 Mapster 服务<span><br><span>builder.Services.AddMapster();<span><br><span><br>// 注册 Mapster 映射规则<span><br><span>MapsterConfig.Register();<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>基础映射一行代码搞定</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>接下来我们分别定义一个源对象（<code>Student</code><span>）和一个目标对象（<code>StudentViewModel</code><span>），它们的属性名和类型完全一致。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Student（源对象）</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaLLrZsrvvoxwIlQiafd3svLTRibmoqbyUIwADXzy2eXF1dMRpruTCYsekwRnr7JqfBBBXA8TB2a4WI/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public<span>&nbsp;classStudent<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; [<span>Display(Name =&nbsp;<span>"学生ID"<span>)<span>]<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicint<span>&nbsp;StudentID {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;班级ID<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; [<span>Display(Name =&nbsp;<span>"班级ID"<span>)<span>]<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicint<span>&nbsp;ClassID {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;学生姓名<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; [<span>Display(Name =&nbsp;<span>"学生姓名"<span>)<span>]<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicstring<span>&nbsp;Name {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;学生年龄<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; [<span>Display(Name =&nbsp;<span>"学生年龄"<span>)<span>]<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicint<span>&nbsp;Age {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;学生性别<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; [<span>Display(Name =&nbsp;<span>"学生性别"<span>)<span>]<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicstring<span>&nbsp;Gender {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>StudentViewModel（目标对象）</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public<span>&nbsp;classStudentViewModel<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;班级ID<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;学生年龄<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; [<span>Display(Name =&nbsp;<span>"班级名称"<span>)<span>]<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicstring<span>&nbsp;ClassName {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; <h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>Mapster 自动完成映射</span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>只要属性名和类型一致，Mapster 自动完成映射，无需任何配置！</span></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaLLrZsrvvoxwIlQiafd3svLTRibmoqbyUIwADXzy2eXF1dMRpruTCYsekwRnr7JqfBBBXA8TB2a4WI/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;private<span>&nbsp;async<span>&nbsp;Task&lt;List&lt;StudentViewModel&gt;?&gt; GetStudentClassInfo(List&lt;Student&gt; students)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// Mapster 映射（无需任何配置！）<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;var<span>&nbsp;studentsListDto = students.Adapt&lt;List&lt;StudentViewModel&gt;&gt;();<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;(studentsListDto?.Count &gt;&nbsp;0<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;var<span>&nbsp;classIDs = studentsListDto.Select(x =&gt; x.ClassID).Distinct().ToList();<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;var<span>&nbsp;querySchoolClassList =&nbsp;await<span>&nbsp;_schoolClassHelper.QueryAsync(x =&gt; classIDs.Contains(x.ClassID)).ConfigureAwait(false<span>);<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;(querySchoolClassList?.Count &gt;&nbsp;0<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;foreach<span>&nbsp;(var<span>&nbsp;studentItem&nbsp;in<span>&nbsp;studentsListDto)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;var<span>&nbsp;getClassInfo = querySchoolClassList.FirstOrDefault(x =&gt; x.ClassID == studentItem.ClassID);<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;if<span>&nbsp;(getClassInfo !=&nbsp;null<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; studentItem.ClassName = getClassInfo.ClassName;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;studentsListDto;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong>映射结果输出：</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202510/1336199-20251020201321367-172227595.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>自定义映射规则</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>当属性名或类型不一致时，可通过配置指定映射逻辑。</span></p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span><span>UserInfo（源对象）</span></span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaLLrZsrvvoxwIlQiafd3svLTRibmoqbyUIwADXzy2eXF1dMRpruTCYsekwRnr7JqfBBBXA8TB2a4WI/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public<span>&nbsp;classUserInfo<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicint<span>&nbsp;Id {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicstring<span>&nbsp;FirstName {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicstring<span>&nbsp;LastName {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicstring<span>&nbsp;Email {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public<span>&nbsp;DateTime CreatedAt {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>UserInfoViewModel（目标对象）</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaLLrZsrvvoxwIlQiafd3svLTRibmoqbyUIwADXzy2eXF1dMRpruTCYsekwRnr7JqfBBBXA8TB2a4WI/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;public<span>&nbsp;classUserInfoViewModel<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicint<span>&nbsp;Id {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;合并 FirstName + LastName<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicstring<span>&nbsp;FullName {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicstring<span>&nbsp;Email {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;格式化日期<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicstring<span>&nbsp;CreatedDate {&nbsp;get<span>;&nbsp;set<span>; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>配置 Mapster 映射规则</span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>在项目根目录创建&nbsp;<code>MapsterConfig.cs</code><span>：</span></span></p>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaLLrZsrvvoxwIlQiafd3svLTRibmoqbyUIwADXzy2eXF1dMRpruTCYsekwRnr7JqfBBBXA8TB2a4WI/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;Mapster 全局映射配置类。<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;用于集中注册项目中所有自定义的对象映射规则，<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;避免映射逻辑分散在各处，提升可维护性与可测试性。<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicstaticclassMapsterConfig<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;注册所有自定义的 Mapster 映射配置<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;此方法应在应用程序启动时（如 Program.cs）调用一次<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>public<span>&nbsp;<span>static<span>&nbsp;<span>void<span>&nbsp;<span>Register<span>(<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; TypeAdapterConfig&lt;UserInfo, UserInfoViewModel&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; .NewConfig()<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; .Map(dest =&gt; dest.FullName,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;src =&gt;&nbsp;<span>$"<span>{src.FirstName}<span>&nbsp;<span>{src.LastName}<span>"<span>.Trim())<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; .Map(dest =&gt; dest.CreatedDate,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;src =&gt; src.CreatedAt.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"<span>));<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>自定义映射规则</span></h3>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span data-cacheurl="" data-remoteid="" data-lazy-bgimg="https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_svg/9M0PhLTmTIeLmnQLStMsiaLLrZsrvvoxwIlQiafd3svLTRibmoqbyUIwADXzy2eXF1dMRpruTCYsekwRnr7JqfBBBXA8TB2a4WI/640?wx_fmt=svg&amp;from=appmsg" data-fail="0"><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;使用 Mapster 映射 UserInfo 示例<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; [ApiController<span>]<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; [<span>Route(<span>"api/[controller]/[action]"<span>)<span>]<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;publicclassUserInfoController<span>&nbsp;:&nbsp;ControllerBase<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;privatereadonly<span>&nbsp;IMapper _mapper;<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;依赖注入<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;param name="mapper"&gt;<span>mapper<span>&lt;/param&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>public<span>&nbsp;<span>UserInfoController<span>(<span>IMapper mapper<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; _mapper = mapper;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;GetUserInfo<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;/summary&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>///<span>&nbsp;<span>&lt;returns&gt;<span>&lt;/returns&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; [HttpGet<span>]<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<span>public<span>&nbsp;List&lt;UserInfoViewModel&gt;&nbsp;<span>GetUserInfos<span>(<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;var<span>&nbsp;userInfos =&nbsp;new<span>&nbsp;List&lt;UserInfo&gt;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;new<span>&nbsp;UserInfo<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Id =&nbsp;999<span>,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; FirstName =&nbsp;"李"<span>,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; LastName =&nbsp;"四"<span>,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Email =&nbsp;"lisi@qq.com"<span>,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CreatedAt = DateTime.Now.AddYears(-5<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; },<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;new<span>&nbsp;UserInfo<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; {<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Id =&nbsp;666<span>,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; FirstName =&nbsp;"张"<span>,<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-10<span>)<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; };<span><br><span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;// 使用 Mapster 映射<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;var<span>&nbsp;getUserInfoViewModels = _mapper.Map&lt;List&lt;UserInfoViewModel&gt;&gt;(userInfos);<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;return<span>&nbsp;getUserInfoViewModels;<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; }<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></span></pre>
